title: Restoration of Sacrifice and Praise under Hezekiah
description: After the temple was cleansed, Hezekiah gathered the city leaders and brought a sin offering for all Israel. The Levites stood ready with David's instruments, and the priests with trumpets. As the burnt offering began, singing and music rose to the Lord. The assembly worshiped, knelt, and brought abundant sacrifices and thank offerings. Because there were so many gifts, the Levites had to help the priests, and service in the house of the Lord was restored with great joy.
